scientific_integrity: Proof by rooted-forest enumerations and elementary asymptotic analysis; finite exhaustive checks are supplementary, not a proof; no claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite labeled trees only; precise complete-leaf-count conditional expectation, not stochastic ordering; the square-root crossover is asymptotic only; exact earlier priority is unverified.
